ctx.x: I know Irving Mills wanted to buy it from her, but ...
Robinson one time asked me to, and asked Duke Ellington -- how about "Perdido" and "Backkiff," and I said, "I put my signature, you write the amount for them." I told Duke, "What are you doing?"
And they don't pay their bills.
